name: Authentication factor
description: Authentication factors are methods registered for a user account.

user_id.label: User
user_id.description: User who owns this authentication factor.
user_id.help: Links the authentication factor to a user account.

type.label: Type
type.help: Identifies the technical mechanism used by the factor.

label.label: Label
label.description: User-facing label for the authentication factor.
label.help: Helps the user distinguish several factors of the same type.

status.label: Status
status.description: Current status of the authentication factor.
status.help: Controls whether the factor can currently be used for authentication.

confirmed_at.label: Confirmed at
confirmed_at.description: Date and time when the authentication factor was confirmed.
confirmed_at.help: Empty until the factor has been validated and activated.

last_used_at.label: Last used at
last_used_at.description: Date and time when the authentication factor was last used.
last_used_at.help: Tracks the latest successful authentication using this factor.

revoked_at.label: Revoked at
revoked_at.description: Date and time when the authentication factor was revoked.
revoked_at.help: Empty until the factor is permanently revoked.

revoked_reason.label: Revocation reason
revoked_reason.description: Reason why the authentication factor was revoked.
revoked_reason.help: Stores an optional explanation for audit or support purposes.
